title: The Distant Interior
author: Astrid Almeida
blurb: Petra Whitlock, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
